items.title: Glueing a Noetherian semi-local domain of dimension one with a discrete valuation ring inside a common field
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma determines the two possible configurations for a Noetherian semi-local domain A of dimension one with a discrete valuation ring B and a common field K as in the glueing situation: either the spectra of A and B are open subschemes covering Spec(R) with K = A tensor_R B, or B dominates one of the local rings of A at a maximal ideal and A tensor B -> K is not surjective. The proof of case (a) uses a unit u of A mapping into the maximal ideal of B, shows A = R_u and then B = R_x for a suitable x, and produces the open cover Spec(R) = D(x) union D(u) (proof lines 7375-7392). Case (b) shows the maximal ideal of A lies in R, then proves A is integral over R by a determinant-style computation in the product of residue fields, and finally that m_A is contained in m_B, so that A cap m_B is a maximal ideal of A dominated by B (proof lines 7395-7413). H2: the two case analyses each require a genuine computation of localizations, and the integrality argument in case (b) is not routine bookkeeping.
